Silhouette: Horizontal lion frame carried on two hind legs, golden eagle wings in place of the forelegs. Host frame: the lion sets the outline, body size and overall frame. A single creature that combines a lion and a golden eagle. Head of the lion, fully visible and uncluttered, with clear, discernible eyes. Details: behavior: lion-typical behavior following the lion head/brain tissue; golden eagle feathers in a few large patches over the forequarters and neck, at full strength with clean edges, color and surface unchanged inside each patch; lion coat everywhere else; ears: rounded lion ears, fully lion tissue; face: lion muzzle and facial features, no beak; feet: lion paws with claws, fully lion tissue; head: head capsule lion, supplying brain; behavior follows head donor; lion skull in place of the skull; skull: lion skull and jaw structure; tail: lion tail fully lion tissue; plain coat, no stripes or spots; golden eagle wings in place of the forelegs, standing on two hind legs; wings held for display or gliding, not powered flight. Coat texture flows along the body outline. Bilaterally symmetrical, recognizable limbs, visible sense organs. Habitat cue (forest): dark back and light belly (mild countershading). One creature, full body, side three-quarter view, plain light background, natural history illustration.
Aspect ratio: 1:1.

**Refining chimera illustration**
